page: Google Cloud Platform g2-standard-12 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine designed for visual computing, AI inference, and media workloads. The instance is built on the x86_64 architecture, powered by an Intel Xeon processor running at 2.2 GHz with 12 dedicated vCPUs (6 physical cores with hyperthreading) and 38 MB of L3 cache. It is provisioned with 48 GB of system memory, matching a standard 4 GB per vCPU ratio. Acceleration is driven by a single NVIDIA L4 GPU featuring 24 GB of VRAM based on the Ada Lovelace architecture. No local storage is bundled with the instance, requiring network-attached storage for persistent operational data.

Performance benchmarks highlight the instance's strengths in accelerator-bound workloads. In large language model inference tests, the g2-standard-12 achieves top-tier results for small (135M) and medium (7B) parameter models, generating 52.93 tokens per second on a 7B model and processing prompts at 2,259.04 tokens per second. Host CPU performance is moderate, showing average multi-core results in Geekbench (5,383) and PassMark CPU tests (10,477.52), while single-threaded tasks like compression and single-core execution register in the lower performance quartiles. Memory bandwidth benchmarks demonstrate 70.9 GB/s for large uncached reads and 42.96 GB/s for uncached writes.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the g2-standard-12 offers an entry-level GPU architecture that balances modest host CPU resources with specialized tensor compute. This hardware configuration is suited for AI inference serving, video transcoding, computer vision, and interactive graphics pipelines that do not require multi-GPU setups or high-frequency single-thread CPU compute.
description: Google Cloud Platform g2-standard-12 is an x86_64 GPU-accelerated virtual machine tailored for AI inference, media processing, and visual computing. Powered by an Intel Xeon processor running at 2.2 GHz, it features 12 dedicated vCPUs across 6 physical cores, 48 GB of system RAM, and a single NVIDIA L4 GPU equipped with 24 GB of VRAM on the Ada Lovelace architecture. The instance includes no bundled local storage. In benchmark evaluations, the g2-standard-12 demonstrates top-tier throughput in small and medium large language model inference, delivering over 52 tokens per second on 7B text generation tasks. Host CPU metrics remain in the average tier for multi-threaded workloads and lower for single-threaded tasks. With its balanced 4 GB per vCPU allocation and dedicated accelerator, this instance fits real-time model serving, video encoding, and graphics rendering workloads.
